correctness.rationale: For each fixed sum s, u=x-y is a bijection over odd residues and 4(x^3+y^3)=s^3+3su^2. The coefficient valuation divides the target fibers into a constant branch and an exact root-congruence branch, with every root multiplicity and target count supplied by p-adic root classification. Independently, equal twofold sums reduce to ab=0 modulo p^ell; counting by valuation and summing over s proves the stated polynomial-in-k energies, with a separate p=3 ramification count. The Fourier normalization follows by twice applying character orthogonality, and CRT factors all composite odd moduli. The companion checker independently tested all 1,382,853 target entries at 21 small prime powers, plus six composite-modulus cases, without using finite tests to justify unbounded claims.
